findings: LDO autonomy: SRC-LDO-100 stream 27 = 22.406 kg/s = 80.7 t/h. For 72 h = 5,807 t = 6,830 m3 at rho 850 kg/m3 (density is not in the database: assumed). 2 x 3,500 m3 = 7,000 m3 gross; with tank heel and freeboard usable is about 90-95 % = 6,300-6,650 m3 = about 66-69 h. Either state 3,500 m3 as working volume or enlarge to about 3,900 m3 gross each; also with one tank out of service only 36 h remain (DP-OWNR-0038 'two tanks of 50 %'). Record LDO density as a design parameter.

LDO resupply: DP-OWNR-0040 25 trucks/day x 30 m3 (assumed) = 750 m3/day against a base-load LDO burn of 2,280 m3/day: resupply covers only about a third, so 72 h storage is the real autonomy; the 500 h/y limit (DP-OWNR-0039) implies about 47,000 m3/year LDO (1,600 truckloads).

Gas preheaters 2 x 120 kW cannot heat the gas: TP-G1 gives 5-25 degC supply and 45-70 barg while HMB stream 2 needs 25 degC at 38 barg; with 23 kg/s, Joule-Thomson cooling of about 15 K plus 20 K lift = about 2.0 MW per heater (sized so). aux_load AL-19 (fuel gas receiving station 60 kW; 20 kW on LDO) omits this: either add about 2 MW electrical winter load to the balance (net output / heat rate) or change to water-bath heaters fed by aux boiler / HRSG heat, or agree the temperature at TP-G1 with the Owner by TQ.

Gas capacity: max GT 23 kg/s (IF-01) = 113,050 Sm3/h at 0.7325 kg/Sm3 plus aux boiler about 900 Sm3/h = 113,950 Sm3/h = 99 % of the firm booking 115,000 (DP-OWNR-0033); only 1 % headroom (HMB max 22.357 kg/s gives 110,780 = 96 %). Avoid aux boiler firing at GT full load or book more firm capacity.

aux_load AL-211 (LDO system 420 kW) is inconsistent with the equipment: 2 forwarding pumps 2 x 30 kW + centrifuge 30 kW + skid 40 kW + unloading pump about 11 kW = about 170 kW; check what AL-211 contains (heating, tank mixers?) and correct one of the two.

Package-level rated_power of 00EGA10, 00EGC10, 00EKA10, 00QHA10 was ambiguous (sum of sub-items or extra consumers): I used 'own consumers not listed as separate tags' to avoid double counting in the load list; the previous values (60, 180, 40, 150 kW) were below or above the item sum without basis (EGC10 180 kW < 3 x 75 kW pumps). Confirm the convention used by the electrical load list.
00QEA10AT001 is described as 'Instrument air dryer (2 x 100 %)' but only one tag exists and there is no AT002 (AT001 then AT003 after-filters); add dryer B (AT002) or correct the description.

00QEA: service air compressor is single (1 x 100 %) while instrument air is 2 x 100 % (A, B); descriptions 'Air compressor A/B (2 x 100 %)' are consistent with AL-16 = 180 kW only if the service compressor runs continuously. Cross-connect service/instrument air is assumed.

00SMA50 BFP hoist 10 t: the boiler feed pump motors are 3,600 kW (10LAC10AP001/2), whose motor alone is about 12-15 t: capacity given as 16 t; description (10 t) needs revision after vendor weights. GT hall crane 120 t and ST hall crane 100 t could not be checked against vendor weights (no weight data in the database): confirm against the heaviest IEC lift (GT rotor / generator rotor incl. lifting beam).

NFPA 20 pump selection: no fire water demand parameter exists in the database; demand derived from assumed tank dimensions (D 20 m x H 11.5 m) and transformer areas. Electric fire pump 160 kW LV instead of the 250 kW placeholder; largest hazard is the LDO tank fire (3,450 L/min + 500 gpm hose); GSU transformer + hose is lower (about 4,950 L/min). Create design parameters for the fire water demand and confirm with the fire protection concept.

00QJA10 'bottle racks / generator' does not state which is meant, so nitrogen rated_power is omitted (a PSA generator would add about 30 kW); the H2/CO2 racks assume a hydrogen-cooled GT generator (AL-02 seal oil / stator water) - confirm with the IEC generator data.
Fire water tanks A/B: 'identical' interpreted as 2 x 100 % (700 m3 each, 642 m3 needed); if the intent is 2 x 50 % the total must be 1,300 m3 or more per tank.
